scope: Compile the multi-strategy positive-reference T-shirt request with the host system Python runtime.
summary: Two host-system-Python launches did not reach task-plan compilation. The first preserved only request.json in a new directory; the second was interrupted before creating its run directory after the interpreter stalled during standard-library import.
evidence: outputs/tshirt-multi-strategy-reference/20260822T043500Z-plan-v1 contains only request.json and no plan, scaling policy, or compile manifest.
The interrupted traceback remained inside the macOS command-line-tools Python 3.9 standard-library import path before PhiAgent planning code executed.
No GPU or model request was launched and no incomplete result was promoted.
lessons: A host Python interpreter stall must be recorded as a not-started environment failure rather than a planner or model failure.
A retry must use a new output directory and the project-managed dependency environment.
next_actions: Rerun the unchanged request with the project .venv-wuji interpreter in a new output directory.
